chunks: But those who believe not in the Hereafter turn away from the straight path.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of not believing in the Hereafter according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the epistemological root of deviation: the denial of the Hereafter (Ma'ad) leads to a fundamental disorientation from the Sirat al-Mustaqim. This aligns with the concept that belief in resurrection is the cornerstone of moral accountability, as those who reject it become 'turned away' from divine truth.
